questions.q: Who wrote The Speed Of Trust?
questions.why: The book was written by Stephen M. R. Covey, not Stephen R. Covey.

questions.q: What is one effect of trust on business operations?
questions.why: Trust allows faster order processing and lower costs, as illustrated by FedEx.

questions.q: Which core is NOT listed as part of developing trust in yourself?
questions.why: The four cores are Integrity, Intent, Capabilities, and Results.

questions.q: What type of trust involves giving back to the community?
questions.why: Societal trust is built by contributing to stakeholders outside employees and customers.

questions.q: Which event is cited to show the impact of lacking societal trust?
a: 1992 LA riots after Rodney King incident
questions.why: The 1992 LA riots are mentioned as a consequence of societal mistrust.
